summary: Iteration 73 — Worker Payment Tracker, VA lost-lead recovery, and NotificationBell clear-all/per-row-X all verified. Seeded a gig_acceptance directly in mongo (geofence-safe fixture), then exercised approve-timesheet + worker-payments list/mark-paid/idempotency + PM lost-lead recovery via pytest (8/8 passed), and drove a full admin E2E through the Worker Pay UI, VA Pipeline, NotificationBell popover, and Bookkeeping regression via Playwright.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> rendered inside <option> in the pipeline stage-filter <select> (AdminVAPipeline.jsx ~line 197). Cosmetic only — does not break the flow — but should be cleaned up.

action_items: Fix React hydration warning in AdminVAPipeline.jsx: don't wrap option label in a <span> inside <option>.
critical_code_review_comments: worker_payments.py mark-paid is correctly idempotent (skip 'already paid') and log_worker_payout_expense in bookkeeping.py uses source_acceptance_id as the idempotency key — verified: 2nd call did NOT create a duplicate ledger entry.
pm.py stage transitions revive commissions from 'rejected' when a lost lead moves to booked — verified: commission.status becomes 'calculating' after lost→quoted→booked.
AdminVAPipeline STAGE_TRANSITIONS.lost now correctly offers all 6 pipeline stages, matching backend which was always permissive.
AdminWorkerPay uses real shadcn Dialog (not window.confirm) with method/reference inputs — good UX for audit trail.
Minor: ledger list endpoint returns {items, totals} — earlier fixture ambiguity between 'items' vs 'entries' response key was resolved (endpoint returns items).

seed_data_creation: Directly seeded TEST_ prefixed gigs, gig_acceptances (with clock_out_at + timesheet_approved), ledger_entries, and va_leads via pymongo. All cleaned up after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_worker_payments_and_pipeline.py is reusable — it seeds its own fixture, runs approve-timesheet, mark-paid (with method/ref), idempotency, not-approved skip, ledger cross-check, and lost-lead recovery through pm/leads/{id}/stage. For UI-only reruns, seed a TEST_uiacc_* gig_acceptance in mongo with timesheet_approved=True, then hit /ops/worker-pay. Notification bell has two DOM instances (desktop + mobile) — always pick the .is_visible() one at 1920px viewport. NotificationBell endpoints DELETE /api/notifications/{id} and DELETE /api/notifications (clear-all) are functional. Bookkeeping payroll category totalled $575 across seeded + real payouts (100% of expenses), confirming worker payouts hit the ledger.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Both new features (worker pay tracker, lost-lead recovery) and the leftover NotificationBell clear-all/per-row-X UI work end-to-end.
